0019_clock_owner_claim_in_place.sql.restorePoint: A verified backup/restore point of the clockgrove database, taken before this migration runs. It drops clockgrove.clock_owner_claims: the clock owner claim lives on the partition row (clock_owner_generation, clock_owner_id) instead.

0029_drop_incompatible_snapshots.sql.restorePoint: A verified backup/restore point of the clockgrove database, taken before this migration runs. It deletes every snapshot index row, all written under the kernel registry that issue 740 replaced; the journal stays the authority and replay runs from birth until new snapshots are written.
